record.question: According to Greenpeace data published on August 19, 2019, which country is the largest emitter of SO2?
record.explanation: Answer C: India. Greenpeace’s 19 August 2019 analysis says India was the world’s largest anthropogenic SO₂ emitter, based on NASA OMI hotspot data. Reference: https://www.greenpeace.org/india/en/press/4015/india-largest-so2-emitter-in-the-world-says-greenpeaces-new-analysis/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
